headlines.description: — Rookie VJ Edgecombe made the go-ahead follow shot with 0.9 seconds left, Tyrese Maxey raced back for a game-saving blocked shot and the Philadelphia 76ers beat the short-handed...
headlines.shortLinkText: Edgecombe has go-ahead basket and Maxey a game-saving block as 76ers beat short-handed Warriors

headlines.description: — Derrick White scored a season-high 30 points, Jordan Walsh added a career-high 22 and the Boston Celtics, playing without Jaylen Brown, routed the Washington Wizards 146-101 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: White scores 30 points, Celtics send Wizards to worst loss of season with 146-101 rout

headlines.description: — Lauri Markkanen scored 30 points, Keyonte George had 29 and the Utah Jazz used a huge fourth quarter to beat the Brooklyn Nets 123-110 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Markkanen scores 30 and the Jazz use a big fourth quarter to beat the Nets 123-110

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Toronto Raptors

headlines.description: — Rui Hachimura made a 3-pointer off a pass from LeBron James as time expired to give the Los Angeles Lakers a 123-120 victory over the Toronto Raptors on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hachimura hits 3 at buzzer on pass from James as Lakers beat Raptors 123-120

events.name: Minnesota Timberwolves at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Julius Randle had 28 points and nine rebounds, carrying Minnesota on a quiet night from Anthony Edwards, and the Timberwolves beat the New Orleans Pelicans 125-116 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Randle scores 28 as the Timberwolves beat the Pelicans again on a quiet night for Edwards
